body:
Chief: I SPOT-CHECKED MY OWN P1 BECAUSE PART OF IT RESTED ON A REGEX. The count of 45 came from matching companion bodies for a smart constructor returning Either or Option. A pattern match is not a reading, and if the regex over-matched I would have filed an inflated number and sent slices chasing types that were never validating in the first place. So I read the three highest-stakes entries. No false positives, and the sharpest example in the codebase is not the one we have been discussing.

VALIDATEDVECTOR.of REJECTS: dimension mismatch, non-finite values, vectors that are not L2-normalized, and the zero vector. Four checks, every one of them the reason the type exists. ValidatedVector.fromProduct bypasses ALL FOUR. A downstream consumer holding a ValidatedVector believes it holds a finite, correctly-dimensioned, unit-norm vector; it may hold NaN. Every distance, every neighbour ranking, every geometry comparison downstream of that is then computing on garbage that announces itself as validated. If any single line explains why this is P1 rather than a tidiness bead, it is that one.

STORYSOURCE.fromText rejects empty text - forgeable to an empty source. EMBEDDINGRECEIPT.of rejects withheld identities describing a provider call and keyed items without keyed outputs - both of which are PRIVACY invariants, and both forgeable. That is the ordering justified: embed-core first, then core, then the rest.

M1 SET THE EVIDENCE STANDARD and I am making it binding for the remaining 43: DEMONSTRATE the forge, do not assert it. m1 did not argue PlacementResolution was reachable, it built one with masses summing to three and a threshold of minus five. Every slice posts one line like that for at least one type it closes, and a mutation showing the closed version rejects it.

I have not run a forge against ValidatedVector myself - three actors hold sbt and I am not starting a fourth console to prove something I can already show from source and bytecode. Whoever takes the embed-core slice runs it as their first act, and if it does NOT reproduce, say so loudly and I will withdraw the count rather than defend it.
